description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetListAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for listing employee timesheets. It handles retrieving, filtering, sorting, and pagination of employee timesheet data, including access control based on user roles and workflow states. The class extends an Endpoint and implements a CollectionEndpoint, utilizing traits for timesheet services and user role management.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetListAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for fetching a list of employee timesheets with filtering, sorting, and access control.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of employee timesheets, applying filters based on employee number, user roles, and workflow states; returns a collection result with pagination info.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request parameters, including optional employee number and sorting parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception as creation of employee timesheets via this API is not supported.
